DONALD ACQUAYE

Multidisciplinary Artist

Donald Acquaye is a multidisciplinary artist based in Manchester, UK. His work moves across media, materials and surfaces rather than staying within one discipline.

He doesn't work to a fixed style or technique. Each piece starts open-ended, and the material and the process decide much of where it goes.

Everything is a canvas. Anything can become art.
